modelFittingAuthorizationRationale: The 28-day real-data audit contains 50 independent participants but only 13 participants with at least one positive window. There are 41 positive windows, but repeated windows from the same athlete are not independent development subjects. Team B contributes only 2 positive windows, and soreness, sleep-quality, and readiness predictors are missing in 41.36% of windows. No clustered/repeated-measures sample-size justification has yet established that this information is adequate for flexible model-family development and calibration. Therefore predictive performance must remain uninspected at this phase.
